timing: Approach 48/50/51px for left/middle/right head, then pad and button move down 6px together; stagger each press by 160ms.
occlusion: Draw full frame first, buttons second, presses third, and only frame sockets clipped to y=0..400 last. Do not draw the full frame last: its conveyor would hide the button bases.
registeredPNGNote: Use *-registered.png at identity placement, or raw source PNGs with the documented transforms. Do not apply transforms twice.
